svg.title: mimeograph fete poster
svg.text: Live folk music from The Muddy Boots
Brindlewick Cricket Club, Hawthorn Lane, Brindlewick
In aid of St. Peter's Church Restoration Fund
Organised by Brindlewick Village Community Association.

g.data-flaw: The list's dash markers are kept on some items and blanked on others, so the items no longer line up, and Live folk music is set far right after a double space.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: marker detection should decide once per list, and a line should not split at a typewriter double space.
